title: Understanding Undesirable Word Embedding Associations
abstract: arXiv:1908.06361v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Word embeddings are often criticized for capturing undesirable word associations such as gender stereotypes. However, methods for measuring and removing such biases remain poorly understood. We show that for any embedding model that implicitly does matrix factorization, debiasing vectors post hoc using subspace projection (Bolukbasi et al., 2016) is, under certain conditions, equivalent to training on an unbiased corpus. We also prove that WEAT, the most common association test for word embeddings, systematically overestimates bias. Given that the subspace projection method is provably effective, we use it to derive a new measure of association called the $\textit{relational inner product association}$ (RIPA). translated_abstract: arXiv:1908.06361v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：词嵌入常因捕捉不良词关联（如性别刻板印象）而受到批评。然而，测量和消除此类偏差的方法仍未被充分理解。我们表明，对于任何隐式进行矩阵分解的嵌入模型，使用子空间投影（Bolukbasi等，2016）事后进行向量去偏，在某些条件下等同于在无偏语料库上训练。我们还证明，最常用的词嵌入关联测试WEAT会系统性地高估偏差。鉴于子空间投影方法被证明有效，我们利用它推导出一种新的关联度量，称为“关系内积关联”（RIPA）。RIPA实验表明，平均而言，带负采样的跳元模型（SGNS）并不会使大多数词比训练语料库中更具性别倾向。然而，对于性别刻板印象词，SGNS实际上会放大这种关联。
tldr: 本文证明子空间投影去偏法在矩阵分解嵌入中等同于无偏训练，并揭示WEAT测试高估偏差，提出新度量RIPA发现SGNS平均不增加性别倾向但会放大刻板词关联。
en_tdlr: This paper shows subspace projection debiasing is equivalent to unbiased training for matrix-factorization embeddings, reveals WEAT overestimates bias, and proposes RIPA, finding SGNS on average doesn't increase gender association but amplifies it for stereotyped words.
